from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

    f = Path(d,".claude","roles",rel); f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); f.write_text("x")
os.environ["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"] = d
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])
import delete_guard as dg
dg.configure(d)
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[2]); import charter
t='| роль | зона |\n|---|---|\n| `Инженер` | код |\n'
c='| роль | зона |\n|---|---|\n| `Инженер` | src/ |\n| `Аналитик` | данные |\n'
print("MERGE:", repr(charter.merge_table_rows(t,c)))
b = Path(d).as_posix()
cmds = ['cp /tmp/x .claude/roles/judge.md', f'cp /tmp/x "{b}/.claude/roles/judge.md"', f'cp "{b}/.claude/roles/judge.md" /tmp/x',
 'cd .claude/roles && cp /tmp/x judge.md', 'cat .claude/roles/judge.md > /tmp/y', 'python -c "open(\'.claude/roles/judge.md\',\'w\').write(1)"',
 'echo hi | tee -a .claude/roles/README.md', 'echo x >> .claude/roles/notes/ceo.md', 'grep -n x .claude/roles/judge.md',
 'git checkout origin/x -- .claude/roles/judge.md', 'cp -r /tmp/roles .claude/', 'dd of=.claude/roles/judge.md if=/tmp/x']
with mock.patch("dguard.policy.dispatcher_role", return_value=None), mock.patch("delete_guard.dispatcher_role", return_value=None):
    for c in cmds:
        r = dg.check_tool({"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":c},"cwd":d})
        print("DENY" if r else "ok  ", c, "::", (str(r)[:90] if r else ""))
shutil.rmtree(d, True)
EOF
